question: What's the capital of France?
notes: Out-of-scope question. expectedRoute is still human_handoff either way, since Program.cs's FAQ branch now has two tiers above the base LowConfidenceCosineDistanceThreshold (0.35): a higher Arcl:OutOfScopeCosineDistanceThreshold (started at 0.55) gets a blunter "that doesn't look like a rules question" message instead of the vaguer "not confident" one, but only bestDistance decides which tier, not the question's actual topic. As measured 2026-09-22, this specific question's real bestDistance against the mens corpus was ~0.464 — below 0.55 — so it currently gets the "not confident" message, not the new out-of-scope one; other clearly-unrelated probes (gibberish text, a cookie recipe question) scored similarly (~0.44-0.47), suggesting 0.55 may be set too high to ever fire for this embedding model/corpus and is worth retuning lower. Either message still routes to human_handoff, so this doesn't affect route accuracy, but if the message-text wording ever gets checked here, know which tier to expect.
